svg.title: Claims processor architecture starting from the member
svg.desc: A member figure sends input into the Next.js frontend, which calls the FastAPI backend. A background agent pipeline of document validator, extraction agent, fraud detector and adjudicator uses the Groq LLM, SQLite database and policy engine, producing a decision with a trace. The member receives only the decision status; the full trace is visible in the admin dashboard.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the member portal in the claims processor do?')
sendPrompt('What can the admin dashboard do in the claims processor?')
sendPrompt('Explain the FastAPI backend and async processing in the claims processor')
sendPrompt('How does the document validator agent work?')
sendPrompt('How does the extraction agent work?')
sendPrompt('How does the fraud detector agent work?')
sendPrompt('How does the adjudicator agent decide claims?')
sendPrompt('Which LLM models does the claims processor use via Groq?')
sendPrompt('What does the SQLite database store in the claims processor?')
sendPrompt('How does the policy engine use policy_terms.json?')
sendPrompt('What does the decision trace contain and who can see it?')
